title: Products with presentation strength numerator 500 (concrete value)
exercises: ECL concrete domain = #500 on a decimal attribute
why: Fast: one literal prop set (value 500). The current FHIRsmith release (tx-dev.fhir.org, recorded 2 Nov 2026 and rechecked 6 Nov) evaluates the concrete value and returns 441 codes, so the engine answer is expected to match; the earlier tx.fhir.org recording was a 400, because its SNOMED cache lacks concrete-value relationships.
